title: Diagnosis Trip Offset on Optional Coverage Add-Ons Cash Settlements
content:
A diagnosis offset is taken off the cash value of a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, for the contractor trips Bridgewell already paid on the request, counted from the contractor assignments the request being settled shows:

| Contractor assignments on the request | Diagnosis offset |
|---|---|
| Two or more | USD 70.00 |
| One | USD 35.00 |
| None | None |

**Hypothetical cases.** A request assigned once and never re-dispatched: USD 35.00. A request assigned and then re-dispatched after a missed contact window: two assignments, USD 70.00. A request with no assignment yet: nothing.
